title: Trigger variable (one line of map/triggers/**/variables.json)
description: variables.json holds one JSON object per line (JSON Lines), each a global variable placed in that folder (docs/trigger-folders-spec.md, section 4); this schema is for one line. Read and written by crates/w3proj/src/trigger_layout.rs. Unknown keys are errors there, so they are refused here too.

name.description: without udg_; not empty, one line (order.txt lists it as $name), unique map-wide

node.description: Reforged: whether the variable is a node of the tree (placed by order.txt's $name); true when missing

parent.description: Reforged, a variable without a node: its parent id as stored; -1 when missing

text.description: a value war3map.wtg stores: no zero character
